title: 😤 Jatin's VLOOKUP returns #N/A... the fourth argument nobody sets #excel #vlookup
title_alts: 🔎 Jatin's VLOOKUP grabs the wrong row... the exact match switch in Excel #excel #vlookup
😬 Jatin's lookup matched the nearest name... the VLOOKUP error to avoid #excel #vlookup
description_hook: A VLOOKUP that returns #N/A is usually not missing data. It is a missing fourth argument, and a stray space.

characters.name: Jatin
characters.description: late twenties, short black hair, grey zip hoodie, pencil tucked behind one ear

scenes.narration: Your VLOOKUP returns #N/A, and the name sits right there.
scenes.caption: VLOOKUP #N/A दिखा रहा है, जबकि नाम वहीं मौजूद है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a wooden home desk showing an Excel sheet where a whole column of formula cells reads #N/A in red, while the name list beside it plainly contains those same names. Warm afternoon window light falls across the keyboard.

scenes.narration: VLOOKUP's last argument decides everything. Leave it blank and Excel guesses.
scenes.caption: VLOOKUP का आख़िरी हिस्सा सब तय करता है। खाली छोड़ा तो Excel अंदाज़ा लगाता है।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel formula bar filling the top of a bright monitor, the VLOOKUP formula ending after the column number with nothing following the last comma, the cursor blinking in the empty space. Even white office light.

scenes.narration: It assumes your list is sorted, then grabs the nearest neighbour.
scenes.caption: वह मान लेता है कि सूची छँटी हुई है, और सबसे नज़दीकी पंक्ति उठा लेता है।
scenes.image_brief: An unsorted Excel column of surnames with an arrow drawn from a searched name to a completely different row two cells below it, the wrong value highlighted in orange. Flat daylight on a tidy desk.

scenes.narration: Open the lookup table. Check the first column holds your search value.
scenes.caption: लुकअप टेबल खोलिए। देखिए कि पहले कॉलम में आपका खोजा जाने वाला मान है।
scenes.image_brief: A second Excel worksheet tab open on screen showing a reference table, its leftmost column of employee codes outlined in a green border, the remaining columns of names and departments to its right. Soft morning light from the left.

scenes.narration: Click the formula. Add FALSE as the fourth argument, after the column number.
scenes.caption: फ़ॉर्मूला पर क्लिक कीजिए। कॉलम नंबर के बाद चौथा तर्क FALSE जोड़िए।
scenes.image_brief: The same Excel formula bar now showing a comma and the word FALSE typed at the end of the VLOOKUP, the closing bracket after it, a tooltip strip beneath naming the range lookup argument. Bright screen glow in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Press Enter. Still #N/A? Wrap the lookup value in TRIM.
scenes.caption: एंटर दबाइए। फिर भी #N/A? लुकअप मान को TRIM में लपेट दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel cell mid-edit with the lookup value now enclosed in a TRIM function inside the VLOOKUP, the nested brackets tinted different colours by the editor. Cool evening light and a mug beside the keyboard.

scenes.narration: Trailing spaces from pasted data break matches invisibly.
scenes.caption: पेस्ट किए डेटा में पीछे छिपी ख़ाली जगह मिलान चुपचाप तोड़ देती है।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel cell in edit mode where the text selection extends two blank character widths past the last letter of a name, the highlight bar making the empty space obvious. Neutral indoor light.

scenes.narration: Type a name you know exists. The right row should appear instantly.
scenes.caption: कोई ऐसा नाम लिखिए जो मौजूद है। सही पंक्ति तुरंत दिख जानी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel sheet where the formula column now shows correct department names on every row, the last red #N/A gone, a typed test name sitting in the input cell above. Clean daylight on a white desk.

scenes.narration: Do not force a match with IFERROR yet.
scenes.caption: IFERROR से मिलान जबरदस्ती बनाने की कोशिश अभी मत कीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel formula wrapped in IFERROR so the column shows tidy blank cells, with a faint outline marking the rows that are silently empty. Dim desk lamp light from one side.

scenes.narration: Hiding #N/A hides real gaps in your data. Fix the data first.
scenes.caption: #N/A छिपाने से डेटा की असली कमी छिप जाती है। पहले डेटा ठीक कीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A printed Excel report on a desk with three rows left completely blank in the department column, a pen resting across those rows. Low warm evening light through a window blind.

scenes.narration: Add FALSE to every VLOOKUP in your sheet today.
scenes.caption: आज ही अपनी शीट के हर VLOOKUP में FALSE जोड़ दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing Excel's find and replace box searching for VLOOKUP across the workbook, a results list of four formula cells beneath it. Warm lamp light on a wooden desk at night.

claims.basis: range_lookup is the fourth argument of VLOOKUP by the function's own signature
VLOOKUP searches only the leftmost column of the given range, by definition

title: 😩 Ruchi's Word contents page is empty... the heading styles she skipped #word #tableofcontents
title_alts: 📑 Ruchi's Word headings look bold... what the Heading 1 style builds #word #tableofcontents
😖 Ruchi restyled a shared Word file... the review mistake to avoid #word #tableofcontents
description_hook: Word does not read bold text as a chapter title. It reads styles, and that is the whole difference.

characters.name: Ruchi
characters.description: early twenties, long braided hair, mustard cardigan, round wire glasses

scenes.narration: Your Word contents page is empty, or missing half the chapters.
scenes.caption: आपका Word वाला विषय-सूची पेज खाली है, या आधे अध्याय गायब हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a long library table showing a Word document open at a page headed Contents with nothing listed below it, thick chapter pages visible in the page thumbnail strip. Cool daylight from tall windows behind the screen.

scenes.narration: Word builds that list from heading styles, not from bold text.
scenes.caption: Word वह सूची हेडिंग स्टाइल से बनाता है, मोटे अक्षरों से नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A Word ribbon styles gallery filling the upper screen with Heading 1 and Heading 2 tiles outlined, and the plain Normal tile highlighted as the one currently applied. Even lamp light on a dark wooden table.

scenes.narration: You made your titles big and bold by hand. Word saw body paragraphs.
scenes.caption: आपने शीर्षक हाथ से बड़े और मोटे किए। Word ने उन्हें साधारण पैरा समझा।
scenes.image_brief: A Word page where three chapter titles are set in large bold type, each showing the word Normal in the style box at the left edge of the ribbon. Soft overhead reading light.

scenes.narration: Turn on the navigation pane. It shows exactly what Word can see.
scenes.caption: नेविगेशन पेन चालू कीजिए। वह दिखाता है कि Word को क्या दिख रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: A Word window with the View tab open and the navigation pane checkbox ticked, a narrow empty sidebar appearing down the left of the document. Bright even daylight.

scenes.narration: If it looks empty, none of your headings are styled.
scenes.caption: अगर वह खाली लगे, तो आपके किसी शीर्षक पर स्टाइल नहीं लगी है।
scenes.image_brief: A blank Word navigation sidebar beside twenty pages of dense text, the sidebar showing only its search box and no entries at all. Neutral indoor light on a library table.

scenes.narration: Click a chapter title. Pick Heading 1 from the styles gallery.
scenes.caption: किसी अध्याय के शीर्षक पर क्लिक कीजिए। स्टाइल गैलरी से Heading 1 चुनिए।
scenes.image_brief: A Word document with the cursor inside a chapter title line and the Heading 1 tile in the styles gallery lit up as selected, the title shifting to the style's own blue type. Warm side light from a window.

scenes.narration: Do the same for sub-sections, using Heading 2.
scenes.caption: उप-अनुब्हागों के लिए वही कीजिए, Heading 2 से।
scenes.image_brief: A Word page showing one Heading 1 chapter title with two smaller sub-section titles beneath it, the navigation sidebar now listing all three in an indented tree. Cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Now put the cursor where the contents belong. Insert table of contents.
scenes.caption: अब कर्सर वहाँ रखिए जहाँ सूची चाहिए। तब टेबल ऑफ़ कंटेंट्स डालिए।
scenes.image_brief: A Word References tab open with the table of contents menu dropped down over an empty page, a preview of an automatic contents layout showing under the cursor. Bright screen light in a dim room.

scenes.narration: The navigation pane should list every chapter. Count them.
scenes.caption: नेविगेशन पेन में हर अध्याय दिखना चाहिए। गिन कर देखिए।
scenes.image_brief: A filled Word navigation sidebar listing seven chapter names in order with indented sub-entries, beside the newly generated contents page. Soft daylight on a wooden table.

scenes.narration: Add a page, then right-click the table and update it.
scenes.caption: एक पेज जोड़िए, फिर सूची पर राइट-क्लिक करके अपडेट कीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A Word contents page with a small context menu open over it offering an update field option, the page numbers beside two chapter entries visibly different from before. Even office light.

scenes.narration: Do not restyle a document someone else is reviewing.
scenes.caption: जिस दस्तावेज़ को कोई और जाँच रहा है, उसकी स्टाइल मत बदलिए।
scenes.image_brief: A Word document in review view with coloured tracked changes down the right margin and four comment bubbles attached to different paragraphs. Cold overcast light from a window.

scenes.narration: Style changes rewrite every tracked comment anchor. Finish the review first.
scenes.caption: स्टाइल बदलने से हर टिप्पणी की जगह बदल जाती है। पहले जाँच पूरी करिए।
scenes.image_brief: A Word page where comment bubbles point at the wrong lines, their connector lines crossing each other over a reflowed block of text. Dim evening light and a closed notebook beside the laptop.

scenes.narration: Style one chapter heading now, before the document grows.
scenes.caption: अभी एक अध्याय के शीर्षक पर स्टाइल लगाइए, दस्तावेज़ बड़ने से पहले।
scenes.image_brief: A single chapter title on a Word page with the Heading 1 style applied and the cursor resting at its end, the navigation sidebar showing its first entry. Warm morning light across the table.

title: 😳 Omkar's PowerPoint fonts shifted on stage... the embed box he skipped #powerpoint #fonts
title_alts: 🔤 Omkar's PowerPoint text reflows elsewhere... what embed fonts does #powerpoint #fonts
😖 Omkar mailed a PowerPoint with his own font... the swap to prevent #powerpoint #fonts
description_hook: A deck that looked right at home can break on a borrowed laptop. The font never travelled with the file.
setting: a college auditorium and its side room

characters.name: Omkar
characters.description: early thirties, close-cropped beard, navy blazer over a white shirt, lanyard badge turned backwards

scenes.narration: Your slides looked perfect. On the projector laptop, everything shifted.
scenes.caption: आपकी स्लाइड्स बेहतरीन लग रही थीं। प्रोजेक्टर लैपटॉप पर सब खिसक गया।
scenes.image_brief: A wide auditorium screen showing a slide where the title has wrapped onto a third line and pushed a bar chart half off the bottom edge, rows of empty seats below. Dark hall lit only by the projector beam.

scenes.narration: Fonts live on your machine, not inside the file.
scenes.caption: फ़ॉन्ट आपके कंप्यूटर में रहते हैं, फ़ाइल के अंदर नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A computer font settings window listing installed typeface names in a long scrollable column, with a small presentation file icon sitting apart from it on the desktop. Even cool light in a quiet side room.

scenes.narration: The other computer has no copy, so it swaps in a substitute.
scenes.caption: दूसरे कंप्यूटर में उसकी नक़ल नहीं होती, इसलिए वह कोई और फ़ॉन्ट लगा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two versions of the same slide side by side, the left one in a narrow elegant typeface and the right one in a wide plain typeface that overflows its text box. Flat neutral light.

scenes.narration: Open the file menu. Find Options, then the Save page.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइल मेन्यू खोलिए। ऑप्शंस, फिर सेव वाला पेज ढूँढिए।
scenes.image_brief: A PowerPoint options dialogue open on a laptop with the Save category selected in its left list, a long panel of checkboxes on the right. Warm side-room lamp light.

scenes.narration: Decide now: characters used only, or the whole font?
scenes.caption: अभी तय कीजिए: सिर्फ़ इस्तेमाल हुए अक्षर, या पूरा फ़ॉन्ट?
scenes.image_brief: A close pair of radio buttons in a settings panel, one offering to embed only the characters used and one offering all characters, neither yet selected. Bright screen glow against a dim wall.

scenes.narration: Tick embed fonts in the file. Choose embed all characters.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइल में फ़ॉन्ट एम्बेड करने का बॉक्स टिक कीजिए। सभी अक्षर वाला विकल्प चुनिए।
scenes.image_brief: The same options panel with the embed fonts checkbox now ticked and the all characters radio button filled in, the OK button beneath it outlined. Even white light on a folding table.

scenes.narration: That keeps editing possible on the borrowed machine.
scenes.caption: इससे उधार लिए कंप्यूटर पर एडिट करना भी मुमकिन रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A slide open for editing on an unfamiliar laptop, a text cursor placed inside a heading that still shows the original typeface shape. Mixed light from a window and a ceiling tube.

scenes.narration: Save the deck again. The file size will jump.
scenes.caption: डेक फिर से सेव कीजिए। फ़ाइल का आकार बढ़ जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A file browser window showing the presentation file with a noticeably larger size value than the older copy beside it in the same folder. Cool daylight through a doorway.

scenes.narration: Copy it to a pen drive. Open it on a different computer.
scenes.caption: इसे पेन ड्राइव में कॉपी कीजिए। किसी दूसरे कंप्यूटर पर खोलिए।
scenes.image_brief: A small pen drive plugged into the side of a laptop with a file copy progress bar on screen showing the presentation being transferred. Warm evening light in a cluttered side room.

scenes.narration: Every heading should sit on the same line as before.
scenes.caption: हर शीर्षक पहले जैसी ही पंक्ति में दिखना चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A slide on a second laptop where the title sits on a single line and the chart below it fills its original space exactly. Clean bright light from a window.

scenes.narration: Some licensed fonts refuse to embed at all.
scenes.caption: कुछ लाइसेंस वाले फ़ॉन्ट एम्बेड ही नहीं होते।
scenes.image_brief: A small warning dialogue over a presentation window stating that a font cannot be saved with the file because of its licence. Dim room with one desk lamp on.

scenes.narration: Then export a PDF and present from that.
scenes.caption: तब PDF बनाइए और उसी से प्रस्तुति दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A PDF of the deck open full screen in a reader, the slide type perfectly placed, a projector remote resting on the table in front of the laptop. Low hall light.

scenes.narration: Embed fonts before you email your next deck.
scenes.caption: अगला डेक भेजने से पहले फ़ॉन्ट एम्बेड कर दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: An email draft on screen with the presentation attached, the cursor hovering over the send button and the options dialogue still visible behind it. Warm morning light on a desk.

title: 😑 Malini's Excel sheet prints on nine pages... the print area she missed #excel #printing
title_alts: 📃 Malini's Excel print spills to nine sheets... what print area fixes #excel #printing
😤 Malini shrank her Excel sheet to fit... the unreadable print to avoid #excel #printing
description_hook: One sheet, nine pages, and a header row on none of them. Print area and print titles fix both in a minute.
setting: a small office beside a shared printer

characters.name: Malini
characters.description: mid forties, silver-streaked bun, teal kurta with rolled sleeves, reading glasses on a beaded chain

scenes.narration: You print one Excel sheet and nine pages come out.
scenes.caption: आप एक Excel शीट छापते हैं और नौ पेज निकल आते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A shared office printer with nine loose printed pages fanned across its output tray, several of them holding only one stray column of numbers. Harsh ceiling tube light on grey carpet.

scenes.narration: Excel prints everything it thinks is used, including stray formatting far right.
scenes.caption: Excel वह सब छापता है जो इस्तेमाल माने, दाईं ओर की बेकार फ़ॉर्मैटिंग भी।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel sheet scrolled far to the right where a single cell carries a yellow fill and a border, hundreds of columns past the last real data. Cool monitor glow in a small office.

scenes.narration: Columns wider than the paper spill onto sheets of their own.
scenes.caption: काग़ज़ से चौड़े कॉलम अलग शीटों पर चले जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Three printed pages laid out on a desk in a row, the third carrying just two narrow columns while the rest of the paper is blank. Flat daylight from a high window.

scenes.narration: Open page break preview. Dashed lines show where every page ends.
scenes.caption: पेज ब्रेक प्रीव्यू खोलिए। बिंदीदार रेखाएँ हर पेज का अंत दिखाती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel sheet in page break preview mode, blue dashed boundary lines cutting through the middle of a wide table and faint page numbers washed behind the cells. Even office light.

scenes.narration: Select only the cells you want printed. Set print area under page layout.
scenes.caption: सिर्फ़ छापने वाली सेल चुनिए। पेज लेआउट में प्रिंट एरिया सेट कीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel table with a rectangular block of cells selected in a marching border, the Page Layout ribbon above showing a print area menu dropped open. Bright screen in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Open the scaling box. Choose fit all columns on one page.
scenes.caption: स्केलिंग बॉक्स खोलिए। सभी कॉलम एक पेज में फ़िट करना चुनिए।
scenes.image_brief: A small scaling dropdown open over an Excel sheet listing width and height fitting options, one entry about fitting all columns on a single page highlighted. Neutral indoor light.

scenes.narration: Add print titles so your header row repeats on every sheet.
scenes.caption: प्रिंट टाइटल जोड़िए ताकि हेडर पंक्ति हर शीट पर दोहराई जाए।
scenes.image_brief: A page setup dialogue with a rows to repeat at top field filled in, pointing at the first row of the underlying Excel table behind it. Cool light from a window on the left.

scenes.narration: Open print preview. The counter should read two pages, not nine.
scenes.caption: प्रिंट प्रीव्यू खोलिए। गिनती दो पेज दिखनी चाहिए, नौ नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel print preview screen showing a tidy full page of data with a page counter beneath it reading page one of two. Even daylight on a clean desk.

scenes.narration: Scroll to the last page. Your header row should still be there.
scenes.caption: आख़िरी पेज तक जाइए। हेडर पंक्ति वहाँ भी होनी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: The second printed page held up in one hand, its top row of bold column headings matching the first page exactly. Warm light from a nearby desk lamp.

scenes.narration: Do not shrink a sheet until nobody can read it. Below sixty percent, print landscape instead.
scenes.caption: शीट इतनी छोटी मत कीजिए कि पढ़ी न जा सके। साठ प्रतिशत से नीचे लैंडस्केप छापिए।
scenes.image_brief: A printed page of numbers reduced so far that the digits are barely legible, lying beside a landscape page of the same table printed at a comfortable size. Bright overhead office light.

scenes.narration: Set a print area on your busiest sheet tonight.
scenes.caption: आज रात अपनी सबसे भरी शीट पर प्रिंट एरिया सेट कीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A dense Excel workbook open on a monitor with the print area menu dropped open over it and a cup of tea beside the mouse. Low warm lamp light in an empty office.

claims.basis: round illustrative figure for a wide sheet printed without a print area, stated as an example

claims.claim: should read two pages, not nine
claims.basis: illustrative before and after for the same example sheet, not a measured result

claims.claim: Below sixty percent, print landscape instead
claims.basis: round illustrative readability threshold offered as a rule of thumb, not a specification

title: 😱 Chetan hit send too early... the Outlook rule he never set #outlook #email
title_alts: ⏳ Chetan's Outlook delay delivery rule... what two spare minutes save #outlook #email
😬 Chetan deferred mail on a shared inbox... the Outlook mistake to avoid #outlook #email
description_hook: Undo send gives you seconds. A deferred delivery rule gives you minutes, on every message you write.
setting: an open-plan office late in the day

characters.name: Chetan
characters.description: mid thirties, thick side-parted hair, rolled-up blue shirt sleeves, a chipped enamel mug always at his elbow

scenes.narration: You spotted the typo one second after hitting send.
scenes.caption: भेजने के एक सेकंड बाद ही आपको टाइपो दिख गया।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a sent email open in a reading pane with an obvious misspelling in its first line, the send button greyed out above it. Late amber light across an open-plan desk.

scenes.narration: Outlook pushes your mail out the moment you press that button.
scenes.caption: Outlook आपका मेल उसी पल बाहर भेज देता है जब आप बटन दबाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An Outlook window with a completely empty Outbox folder selected and the Sent Items count beside it just ticked up by one. Cool screen light in a dimming office.

scenes.narration: Undo send holds it for a few seconds only. Then it is gone forever.
scenes.caption: अनडू सेंड उसे कुछ ही सेकंड रोकता है। उसके बाद वह हमेशा के लिए चला गया।
scenes.image_brief: A small undo notification strip fading out at the bottom of a mail window, its countdown already finished and the link no longer clickable. Blue evening light through a large window.

scenes.narration: Close the message you are drafting. This is an account-wide setting.
scenes.caption: जो संदेश लिख रहे हैं उसे बंद कीजिए। यह पूरे अकाउंट की सेटिंग है।
scenes.image_brief: An Outlook main window with no compose windows open, only the folder list and message list visible, a saved draft sitting in the Drafts folder. Warm desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Open the file tab, then manage rules and alerts.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइल टैब खोलिए, फिर मैनेज रूल्स एंड अलर्ट्स।
scenes.image_brief: The Outlook backstage file page open on screen, a button labelled manage rules and alerts highlighted among the account tools. Even office ceiling light.

scenes.narration: Create a new rule that applies to messages you send.
scenes.caption: एक नया रूल बनाइए जो आपके भेजे संदेशों पर लगे।
scenes.image_brief: A rules wizard dialogue open with a blank rule template list, the option for applying a rule to messages you send selected. Bright screen against a darkened room.

scenes.narration: Skip every condition. Pick the action that defers delivery by minutes.
scenes.caption: हर शर्त छोड़ दीजिए। डिलीवरी टालने वाली क्रिया चुनिए।
scenes.image_brief: A rules wizard step listing action checkboxes, every condition box left unticked above and a defer delivery action ticked below. Neutral indoor light on a keyboard.

scenes.narration: Set two minutes. Save the rule and give it a clear name.
scenes.caption: दो मिनट रखिए। रूल सेव कीजिए और उसे साफ़ नाम दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A tiny numeric spinner dialogue set to two minutes, with a rule name field filled in behind it and a finish button ready. Warm light from a single lamp.

scenes.narration: Send yourself a test. It should sit in Outbox, not Sent.
scenes.caption: खुद को एक टेस्ट मेल भेजिए। वह आउटबॉक्स में रहे, सेंट में नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: An Outlook folder list where Outbox shows a bold count of one, the waiting test message visible in the list beside it in italics. Cool blue screen glow.

scenes.narration: Watch the clock. The message leaves exactly two minutes later.
scenes.caption: घड़ी देखिए। संदेश ठीक दो मिनट बाद निकलेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A desk clock beside a monitor where the Outbox has just emptied and the test message now appears at the top of Sent Items. Last daylight fading on the desk surface.

scenes.narration: Do not do this on a shared support mailbox.
scenes.caption: साझा सपोर्ट मेलबॉक्स पर ऐसा मत कीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A shared mailbox folder tree with a queue of customer enquiries and several agent names listed as owners in a side panel. Flat fluorescent light in a support room.

scenes.narration: Colleagues will think your replies were never written. Keep this rule personal.
scenes.caption: साथी समझेंगे कि आपने जवाब ही नहीं लिखा। यह रूल निजी रखिए।
scenes.image_brief: Two monitors at neighbouring desks showing the same shared inbox, one with a reply sitting unsent in the Outbox and the other showing the enquiry still marked unanswered. Harsh overhead light.

scenes.narration: Build that two-minute rule before your next long reply.
scenes.caption: अगले लंबे जवाब से पहले दो मिनट का वह रूल बना लीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: An Outlook rules list on screen containing a single named rule with its checkbox ticked and a long unsent draft visible behind the dialogue. Warm evening lamp light.

claims.basis: round illustrative timing describing the familiar moment of regret, not a measurement
illustrative description of a short recall window, deliberately left unquantified
round illustrative delay chosen for the example; any value can be entered
follows arithmetically from the two-minute deferral configured in the previous step

title: 😵 Shalini's pivot table shows last month... the refresh step she forgot #excel #pivottable
title_alts: 🔄 Shalini's Excel pivot misses new rows... what a real table fixes #excel #pivottable
😖 Shalini typed a fix into her pivot table... the refresh that erased it #excel #pivottable
description_hook: A pivot table reports on a snapshot, not on your sheet. Turn the source into a real table and it keeps up.
setting: a small shop back room with a single monitor
protagonist_type: shop owner tracking her own sales

characters.name: Shalini
characters.description: late twenties, hair clipped up with a pencil through it, olive green shirt, ink smudge on her left thumb

scenes.narration: Your pivot table still shows last month's totals.
scenes.caption: आपका पिवट टेबल अब भी पिंले महीने के आंकड़े दिखा रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor in a shop back room showing an Excel pivot table whose totals row is clearly smaller than the long sales list visible on the sheet tab behind it. Single bare bulb overhead.

scenes.narration: A pivot table reads a saved snapshot. Not the live sheet.
scenes.caption: पिवट टेबल सहेजा हुआ स्नैपशॉट पढ़ता है। लाइव शीट नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel pivot table options panel showing a stored data source range written as a fixed cell reference, the range text outlined. Cool monitor glow in a dark room.

scenes.narration: New rows below your data sit outside the recorded range.
scenes.caption: डेटा के नीचे जुड़ी नई पंक्तियाँ दर्ज दायरे से बाहर रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel sales sheet with a blue border stopping partway down the column and eight newer rows of entries continuing below it, outside the border. Even daylight from a small window.

scenes.narration: Go to the source sheet. Where does the data now end?
scenes.caption: सोर्स शीट पर जाइए। डेटा अब कहाँ ख़त्म होता है?
scenes.image_brief: An Excel sheet scrolled to the bottom of a sales list, the last filled row and the first empty row both visible with the row numbers legible at the left. Warm side light from a doorway.

scenes.narration: Select any single cell inside that block.
scenes.caption: उस हिस्से के अंदर कोई एक सेल चुनिए।
scenes.image_brief: One Excel cell in the middle of a dense data block outlined by the selection box, the name box above showing its address. Neutral indoor light.

scenes.narration: Press Ctrl T to turn the range into a proper table.
scenes.caption: Ctrl T दबाकर उस दायरे को असली टेबल बना दीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: A small create table dialogue over an Excel sheet with a detected range filled in and a my table has headers checkbox ticked. Bright screen in a dim back room.

scenes.narration: Tables stretch on their own as new rows arrive.
scenes.caption: टेबल नई पंक्तियाँ आने पर ख़ुद फैल जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel table with banded rows where a freshly typed entry at the bottom has already taken on the band colour and pulled the table border down with it. Cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Back on the pivot, change the source to that table name.
scenes.caption: पिवट पर लौटकर सोर्स बदलिए, उसी टेबल के नाम पर।
scenes.image_brief: A change data source dialogue over a pivot table, the old cell reference replaced by a short table name typed into the field. Warm lamp light on a cluttered desk.

scenes.narration: Right-click the pivot. Refresh. The grand total should change.
scenes.caption: पिवट पर राइट-क्लिक कीजिए। रिफ़्रेश। कुल जोड़ बदलना चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A pivot table with a context menu open over it and a refresh entry highlighted, the grand total cell beneath showing a visibly larger figure. Bright screen light.

scenes.narration: Compare it against a quick SUM of the same column.
scenes.caption: उसी कॉलम के तेज़ SUM से उसकी तुलना कीजिए।
scenes.image_brief: Two figures side by side on an Excel sheet, a pivot grand total and a plain SUM formula result in a spare cell, both showing the same value. Even daylight.

scenes.narration: Never type numbers inside a pivot table. Your next refresh erases them.
scenes.caption: पिवट टेबल के अंदर संख्या कभी मत लिखिए। अगला रिफ़्रेश उन्हें मिटा देगा।
scenes.image_brief: A pivot table cell holding a hand-typed corrected figure, and the same cell shown again after refreshing with the original computed value back in place. Dim room with one lamp.

scenes.narration: Convert one source range into a table this week.
scenes.caption: इस हफ़्ते एक सोर्स दायरे को टेबल में बदलिए।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel workbook open on a monitor with a plain data range selected and the create table shortcut hint showing, a notebook of handwritten sales figures beside the keyboard. Warm morning light.
